recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-33955. Revisit the cpb-4 explanatory wording only if FHIR-54050 or a successor issue reaches a final applied/published disposition.
issue_request: FHIR-33955 requested an invariant on CapabilityStatement.rest so only one rest repetition is allowed per mode.
initial_application: The issue was applied in commit 071000dbe268d8a21cd01b391af8613807371d67, which added cpb-4 with expression rest.mode.isDistinct() to source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-CapabilityStatement.xml. Commit 49b86f8a6978650d8f8a6d36d27dee0433e455bc later reformatted/refactored the StructureDefinition while preserving cpb-4.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement is active in source/fhir.ini, so the checked StructureDefinition is in build scope. The linked Zulip discussion supports one rest repetition for client mode and one for server mode. FHIR-54050 later raised a wording concern about cpb-4 using should rather than SHALL/must, but that issue is Triaged and unresolved, so it is background only.
reconciliation: No source change was made because current source already has cpb-4 as an error-level CapabilityStatement constraint, expression rest.mode.isDistinct(), and condition references on CapabilityStatement.rest and CapabilityStatement.rest.mode.

related_jiras.note: Triaged/unresolved R6 issue asking whether cpb-4's human wording should say SHALL/must rather than should; not a final decision for this reconciliation.
